[Warder Class Transfer]:
In order to become a Soul Breaker, you must successfully complete a quest, Proof of the Soul Breaker, which may be undertaken at level 39. To embark on it, visit Grand Master Bitus of Town of Giran.
[The Class Master]:
Rather than the quest, from level 40 you may visit the Class Master in Giran, next to the Arena. Clear his short trial, alone in a private hall, and he grants your new class at once.
